title: On feasibility problems with spectral constraints
summary: We study matrix feasibility problems "find X in K intersect C" where K is a closed convex matrix set and C = {X : sigma(X) in S} is defined by a convex constraint S on the ordered singular values. Using the classical spectral transfer identity, projection onto C reduces to an SVD plus a small quadratic program. For seven natural polyhedral S we embed this projector in a plain alternating projection (AP) loop.
